\label{lemma-base-change-div}
Let $(A, \text{d}, \gamma)$ be as in
Definition \ref{definition-divided-powers-dga}.
Let $R \to R'$ be a ring map.
Then $\text{d}$ and $\gamma$ induce similar structures on
$A' = A \otimes_R R'$ such that $(A', \text{d}, \gamma)$ is as in
Definition \ref{definition-divided-powers-dga}.
statement:
Throughout, $R$ is a commutative ring and $(A,\mathrm d,\gamma)$ denotes a nonnegatively graded, strictly graded-commutative differential graded $R$-algebra equipped with a divided power structure on its positive-even part; compatibility with the differential means $\mathrm d(\gamma_n(x))=\mathrm d(x)\gamma_{n-1}(x)$ for homogeneous $x$ of positive even degree.
Let $(A, \text{d}, \gamma)$ be as in
the compatible divided-power DGA notion specified in the opening context.
Let $R \to R'$ be a ring map.
Then $\text{d}$ and $\gamma$ induce similar structures on
$A' = A \otimes_R R'$ such that $(A', \text{d}, \gamma)$ is as in
the compatible divided-power DGA notion specified in the opening context.
hypotheses:
Let $(A, \text{d}, \gamma)$ be as in
the compatible divided-power DGA notion specified in the opening context.
Let $R \to R'$ be a ring map.
conclusions:
Then $\text{d}$ and $\gamma$ induce similar structures on
$A' = A \otimes_R R'$ such that $(A', \text{d}, \gamma)$ is as in
the compatible divided-power DGA notion specified in the opening context.
semantic_review_note: For a compatible divided-power differential graded R-algebra (A,d,γ), every ring map R→R' induces the same differential and PD structure on A⊗_R R'. The final retains the positive-even divided-power domain, differential compatibility and arbitrary base change.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-divided-powers-on-tor}
Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Let $S$ and $T$ be commutative $R$-algebras.
Then there is a canonical structure
of a strictly graded commutative $R$-algebra with divided powers on
$$
\operatorname{Tor}_*^R(S, T).
$$
